summary: Direct3D device-loss recovery: queries device state through interface vtable slots (interface pointer at this+0x1100), resets the device when it reports the lost / not-reset state, tears down and recreates render targets and an additional swap chain, restores device state, and sets flag bit 2 on the caller result a3 when the reset completed.

operations.description: Invoke device vtable slot 0x3C (device state query, TestCooperativeLevel-style) via the interface pointer stored at this+0x1100; store the HRESULT at this+0. If the result != -2005530520 (device lost), return 0.
Invoke device vtable slot 0xC (state re-query) and store the result at this+0; if the result != -2005530519 (device not reset), return 0.
Invoke device vtable slot 0x7C (Reset) with two null arguments; capture the old present-parameters pointer stored at this+0x152C into a local.
sub_53F6E0 cleanup pass over this using the captured present-parameters pointer from this+0x152C.
RenderTargetCleanup(this, a3): releases existing render targets before they are recreated.
Invoke device vtable slot 0x38 (SetDisplayMode-style) with the device and this+0x1104; store the result at this+0.

Error path: if the SetDisplayMode-style result is nonzero, format "%s - 0x%X" (format literal at 0x005DBCE4) with the aCouldNotSetDis message (0x005DBCF0) and the code (re-querying vtable slot 0xC when the code equals -2005530520), report it via sub_53C590(-1, message) and return -1.
Invoke device vtable slot 0x40 (CreateAdditionalSwapChain-style) with the device, two null arguments and the present-parameters pointer at *(this+0x1528)+0xC; store the result at this+0.
Invoke vtable slot 8 on the newly created swap-chain object located at *(*(this+0x1528)+0xC); this release/commit step follows the swap-chain recreation.
Map the display-mode selector at this+0x1114 to a present/format flag word via the jump table jpt_555F7E / byte_55602C: case 2 -> 32, case 3 -> 256, case 4 -> 64, case 0x10 -> 0x100000, default 0.
sub_53F3F0 recreation pass over this, a2, the swap-chain configuration at this+0x1528, the present parameters at this+0x152C, and the mapped flag word.
Invoke device vtable slot 0x7C (Reset) a second time with present-parameters pointers read from *(this+0x1528)+0xC and *(this+0x152C)+0xC; store the result at this+0.
sub_53EB70 restore pass over this with the caller argument a3 after the successful reset.
If a3 is nonzero, FlagBitSetter(a3, 2) sets bit 2 on the caller result marking the device reset; the success path returns -2.
